note: Human-readable base rules for ClaimCheck. Points add up; a claim is flagged at a score of 40 or more.

rules.description: Claim filed within 30 days of the policy starting.
rules.name: claim soon after policy start

rules.description: Repair estimate is more than 85% of the vehicle value.
rules.name: inflated repair estimate

rules.description: Same claimant has 3 or more claims in 12 months.
rules.name: claimant velocity

rules.description: Same repair shop has 10 or more claims in 30 days.
rules.name: repair shop velocity

rules.description: Claim matches an earlier claim on the same policy.
rules.name: duplicate claim

rules.description: Four or more injuries reported for one incident.
rules.name: many injuries reported

rules.description: Claimant has 2 or more prior claims.
rules.name: repeat claimant history

rules.description: No police report filed. Weak on its own; only 10 points.
rules.name: no police report on a large claim
